prompt: src.ts is up for design review. Walk me through every SOLID violation you can find in it, and what you'd do about each. Don't edit the file — I want the diagnosis before anyone touches code.
assertions: file-unmodified: src.ts byte-identical to the input fixture
found-interface-segregation: names PaymentProvider as too wide and LegacyAdyen's throws as the evidence
found-liskov-break: calls out verifyCard always returning true and/or the raising stubs as substitutability failures
found-dependency-inversion: calls out Checkout constructing StripeProvider and TaxEngine calling fetch directly
found-single-responsibility: calls out TaxEngine owning both tax math and audit-log HTTP
open-closed-honest: addresses the region if-chain and states whether that set is actually open before recommending a change
recommends-against-something: at least one explicit 'don't abstract this' or 'leave as is' recommendation
grounded-in-symbols: findings quote real symbol names from src.ts
expected_output: A diagnosis naming I (fat PaymentProvider forcing throws in LegacyAdyen), L (Adyen stubs that raise and verifyCard that always returns true), D (Checkout news up StripeProvider; TaxEngine calls fetch directly), S (TaxEngine does math and audit logging). It should also note the region if-chain and say honestly whether it is worth opening, and must not modify src.ts.
